column1: I'm starring in a new movie...called 'Looking for Love In Several Wrong Places.' You should check it out!
column2: 「我主演了一部新電影……叫《在幾個錯誤的地方尋找愛情》。你應該去看看！」

column1: Do you know when the bus to Coarsegold will arrive?
column2: 「你知道前往科斯戈爾德的公車什麼時候到嗎？」

column1: If you get a chance, call my producers at Sierra and tell them I might be a little late.
column2: 「有機會的話，打給 Sierra 的製片人，告訴他們我可能會晚一點。」

column1: Say that I've run into woman troubles, and I'm tied up right now.
column2: 「告訴他們我遇到女人方面的麻煩，目前脫不了身。」

column1: Thanks.
column2: 「謝謝。」

column1: Well, next time I'm in town we should get down and party!.
column2: 「下次我進城時，我們該好好狂歡！」

column1: Good. I hope it comes soon. The producer and director will be really upset if I don't get to Coarsegold soon.
column2: 「很好。我希望它快點到。要是我不能盡快到科斯戈爾德，製片人和導演會很生氣。」

column1: Well don't feel bad, 'cause I don't either.
column2: 「別難過，因為我也不難過。」

column1: Well, I hope it comes soon.
column2: 「好吧，我希望它快點到。」

column1: The door to the plane is closed because there IS no plane!
column2: 飛機艙門關著，因為根本沒有飛機！

column1: The flight just departed. You missed it. Too bad!
column2: 航班剛起飛，你錯過了。真可惜！

column1: Whoops! You almost had a nasty tumble when you tried to go down the 'Up' escalator.
column2: 糟糕！你試圖走下「上行」手扶梯時，差點摔得很慘。

column1: The guard says: "I'm gettin' dizzy watchin' you go in and out of this gate, mac."
column2: 警衛說：「老兄，看你進進出出這個登機門，我都快暈了。」

column1: You pass through the metal detector without setting off the alarm.
column2: 你通過金屬探測器，沒有觸發警報。

column1: Keith sees You leaving and says: "Hey, Sonny! Wait for me!"
column2: 基斯看見你要離開，說：「嘿，桑尼！等等我！」

column1: The boarding and receiving area is equipped with a metal detector. A security guard mans his post.
column2: 登機與接待區設有金屬探測器，一名保全警衛在崗位上值勤。

column1: You're in the connecting tunnel between the gate and the plane. Out the window you see just how busy Lytton Airport has become.
column2: 你在登機門與飛機之間的連接通道裡。從窗外看去，萊頓機場已變得多麼繁忙。

column1: You gaze out across the runway and think of places far away.
column2: 你凝望跑道另一端，想著遙遠的地方。

column1: You look out past the parking lot, and see the city in the distance.
column2: 你越過停車場望出去，看見遠處的城市。

column1: Looks solid enough. Probably won't cave in.
column2: 看起來夠堅固，大概不會塌下來。

column1: The carpet really needs cleaning. The gum chewers seem to have been having a field day.
column2: 地毯真的需要清潔。嚼口香糖的人似乎在這裡大肆作為。

column1: The chairs are for the comfort of the waiting passengers, even though they appear to be made deliberately uncomfortable.
column2: 椅子是給候機旅客休息的，雖然看起來像是故意做得不舒服。

column1: They don't put chairs in places like this.
column2: 這種地方不會放椅子。

column1: The painting reminds you of a place you would like to be.
column2: 這幅畫讓你想起一個你想去的地方。

column1: You have to be closer to see the painting clearly.
column2: 你得靠近一點才能看清楚畫。
